source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of osmoregulators and osmoconformers (PDF 4).

items: Osmoconformers apni jism ki rutoobaton ki osmotic concentration ko mahol ke barabar rehne dete hain; mahol ke saath isotonic rehte aur apni concentration qaim nahi rakh sakte. Yeh aisi jagah rehte hain jahan madde ki miqdar mustahkam ho, jaise samundar: tamam samundari invertebrates, kuch meethe pani ke invertebrates, aur kuch samundari vertebrates jaise hagfishes, sharks aur rays.

Osmoregulators bahar ki tabdeeli ke bawajood jism ki rutoobaton mein pani aur madde ki concentration mustaqil rakhte hain, namak ki active transport, namak jama karne aur pani bachane se. Zyada tar aabi aur zameeni vertebrates osmoregulators hain.

blocks.prompt: Osmoregulators aur osmoconformers ki tareef ek ek misal ke saath kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Osmoconformers jism ki rutoobaton ko mahol ke mutabiq rehne dete (samundari invertebrate jaise starfish, ya hagfish); osmoregulators mahol kuch bhi ho rutoobatein mustaqil rakhte (meethe pani ki machhli ya insaan).

items: Osmoconformers mahol ke barabar (samundari invertebrates); osmoregulators apni concentration khud qaboo (zyada tar vertebrates).
